food_notes: Retailer test: every pick is Woolworths (national stores, rand prices, local stock) and the four kept lines are Faithful to Nature (South African, rand, CPT and JHB warehouses, collect in store). No retailer added.

Grass-fed and pasture-raised: every grass-fed beef or pasture-raised chicken found today (Organic Choice, Bay Meat Market, L.A. Farms, Ethical Meats, Spier, Living Natural) is a small or single-outlet shop that fails the test. Drop 'grass-fed' and the Braeside text from the app and MP_WHY. The Woolworths label claims are 'free range', 'free to roam pastures and natural veld' and, on the mince only, 'cattle eat grass within their diet'.

Woolworths prices differ by region: each page carries three price lists (plist3620006/8/9), and the JSON-LD shows the default list (plist3620008). Potatoes cost 29.99 to 32.99 and green beans 32.99 to 35.99, depending on the list. Which list Johannesburg gets could not be confirmed. The default list is used, and his shelf price can differ by a few rand.

Eggs: the organic pack is mixed sizes (>33 g each). The current 24 eggs a week (about 1,190 g by the plan's 51 g eggs) may come out short by weight: 24 small eggs are about 800 g. Meal text now counts eggs by weight. The same-size fallback is Free Range Large 18 pk at R91.99 (verified 17 Nov 2026, not organic).
Bread: the label puts one slice at 50 g, so 2 slices are 100 g, not the 90 g the researcher used. That correction moves Day B breakfast protein +3.1% (flagged). Every other meal stays within 3%.

Weekly cost of the seven replaced lines: 299.96 + 45.00 + 84.99 + 155.00 + 43.99 + 47.13 + 113.98 = R790.05, against R809.30 for the lines they replace (169.33 + 99.97 + 130.00 + 155.00 + 76.00 + 39.00 + 140.00). The four Faithful to Nature lines are unchanged at R471.99.

The organic labels on the egg and potato listings are Woolworths' own attribute ('Certifications: Organic'), and Woolworths names no certifier. The Faithful to Nature EU, Ecocert and USDA organic traits come from the retailer page. None of these was checked on a certifier's database, so treat each as a retailer claim (cert.verified false).

Chicken and rump have no nutrition table on their pages, and the USDA proxies 171077 and 2727574 could not be re-read today because the USDA API hit its rate limit. Potato 170026 was re-read today (77 kcal, 2.05 g).
